title: Only a grid save asks Change All
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts' and 'See Financial Data'.
  • Have a new matrix for this test, matrix A, pricing two new categories made for this test, category A and category B.
  • Have a new category for this test, category C, on the General Matrix.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Click the Matrices tab on Settings › Pricing.
  2. Click matrix A's name on the Matrices list.
  3. Click matrix A's name.
  4. Type a new name no other matrix uses.
  5. Click outside the name field.
  6. Click Edit.
  7. Pick category C in the Categories picker.
  8. Click Save.
  9. Click the Part Sale Matrix tab.
  10. Switch Separate Part Sale pricing on.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Matrix A is listed.

Step 2:

  • Matrix A's page opens.

Step 3:

  • The name can be edited.

Step 4:

  • The field shows the new name.

Step 5:

  • The new name is saved with no question.

Step 6:

  • The grid is in edit.

Step 7:

  • Category C is ticked.

Step 8:

  • Matrix A saves its categories with no Change Prices question (no grid value changed).
  • The Categories line names category A, category B and category C.

Step 9:

  • The switch shows, off.

Step 10:

  • The Part Sale grid shows at once, with no question.
